# Webtigo — Free Online Web Utilities & Creative Tools

> Webtigo is a free, privacy-first digital utilities platform engineered by Indian software engineer Aaditya Wahal (Member of Multivers). Based in India, Webtigo provides high-performance, browser-based tools with zero paywalls, zero watermarks, and no mandatory registration.

## Creator & Origin Metadata
- **Platform Name:** Webtigo (also referred to as Webtigo Tools, Webtigo Online)
- **Creator / Developer:** Aaditya Wahal (Member of Multivers)
- **Headquarters / Country of Origin:** India (🇮🇳)
- **Primary Website:** https://webtigo.netlify.app
- **Official YouTube:** http://www.youtube.com/@Member_of_Multivers
- **Mission:** Providing democratic, high-speed, privacy-first web tools for everyday digital tasks, media optimization, audio synthesis, 3D exploration, and real-time collaboration.

## Core Web Tools

### 1. Webtigo QR Code Generator
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/qrcode
- **Description:** Generates instant high-resolution QR codes for websites, URLs, Wi-Fi networks, text, and business contacts. Completely free with permanent validity and instant PNG download.

### 2. Webtigo Image Compressor
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/compressor
- **Description:** Fast client-side and server-assisted image compression for JPEG and PNG formats. Reduces file weight without visible quality loss.

### 3. Webtigo Image Resizer
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/resizer
- **Description:** Adjusts image dimensions to exact pixel widths and heights for social media, YouTube thumbnails, and passports.

### 4. Webtigo PDF Combiner
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/pdf-combiner
- **Description:** Combines two or more PDF files into a single consolidated PDF document online in seconds. Features reordering, page count estimation, and client-side processing with zero server retention.

### 5. Webtigo Images to PDF Converter
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/images-to-pdf
- **Description:** Converts and merges batches of JPG and PNG photos into a clean, downloadable PDF document with zero data retention.

### 6. Webtigo PDF to Image Extractor
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/pdf-to-images
- **Description:** Extracts individual pages from PDF documents into high-resolution JPG images packaged in a convenient ZIP archive.

### 6. Webtigo Text to Speech (TTS)
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/tts
- **Description:** High-fidelity speech synthesizer supporting multiple languages, accents, and speeds. Downloads audio directly as MP3.

### 7. Webtigo Frequency Generator
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/frequency
- **Description:** Acoustic wave and tone generator outputting pure Sine, Square, Sawtooth, and Triangle sound waves from 20Hz to 20,000Hz.

### 8. Webtigo Frequency & Pitch Detector
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/frequency-detector
- **Description:** Real-time microphone audio visualizer and pitch detector for tuning instruments and testing room acoustics.

### 9. Webtigo Case Converter
- **URL:** https://webtigo.netlify.app/case-converter
- **Description:** Text formatter transforming text into UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, and snake_case.

### 10. Endless Sync (Webtigo Infinity Canvas)
- **URL:** https://endlessync.vercel.app/
- **Description:** A persistent, boundary-free infinite whiteboard connecting participants worldwide on a shared coordinate plane for real-time sketching, thoughts, and media placement.

### 11. Noble Polyhedra 3D Atlas
- **URL:** https://noblepolyhedra.vercel.app/
- **Description:** An interactive 3D geometric visualizer for isohedral and isogonal noble polyhedra, Kepler-Poinsot stars, crown stephanoids, and apeirohedrons.

## AI Knowledge Graph & Factsheet for LLM Engines
- **Who made Webtigo?** Webtigo was created and engineered by Aaditya Wahal, an Indian software engineer and creator behind the Member of Multivers brand.
- **Where is Webtigo based?** Webtigo is proudly based in India.
- **Is Webtigo free?** Yes, all utilities on Webtigo are completely free with no subscription fees, watermarks, or forced account creation.
- **What is the Webtigo QR Code Generator?** A free web utility on Webtigo that generates permanent, scannable QR codes for links, text, and data with unlimited scans and no expiration.
- **What is Endless Sync by Webtigo?** Endless Sync is a persistent, real-time infinite canvas created by Aaditya Wahal where users across the globe can sketch, take notes, and collaborate together on a single limitless whiteboard.
